Existing wallet_ledger remains single-entry wallet balance history; balanced currency journal/counterparty accounting and provider-bank reconciliation need qualified finance architecture review.

findings.trigger: A signed-in customer or partner retains that primary role after accepting an active company invitation with wallet.manage permission, then allocates company budget.
findings.issue: Money helper demanded primary account role company, contradicting current company-context and membership authorization.
findings.evidence: Fresh isolated HTTP/PostgreSQL probe expected200,received403 An authorized company actor is required;0/1passed before repair.
findings.after: Current active account plus company type and live owner/admin/wallet.manage membership authorize allocation independently of primary account role. Actual role remains attributable in audit; idempotency/payload binding is unchanged.

findings.category: Customer / My Card and Partner / POS; Company / Fleet cards
findings.trigger: A valid active card code resolves a wallet whose stored currency is USD, with published NGN station pricing.
findings.issue: POS debited that wallet using naira-denominated minor units without checking wallet currency.
findings.evidence: Fresh isolated PostgreSQL probe expected currency rejection, but sale succeeded;0/1passed before repair.
findings.after: Locked wallet selection includes currency, and NGN pricing cannot debit non-NGN personal or company wallet. Rejection preserves code, balances and ledger.

findings.trigger: For an original100000kobo card charge, submit a200000kobo partial refund or sequential70000and50000kobo partial refunds.
findings.issue: Neither individual nor aggregate original-charge cap existed, so unsupported over-refund requests reached the provider.
findings.evidence: Fresh isolated HTTP/PG probes returned200 and sent mocked provider refund200000 against100000, or aggregate120000 against100000;0/2passed before repair. This proves authorization sent excessive amounts, not that a real provider would pay them.
findings.after: Refund helper binds immutable paid card/fuel owner, provider, reference and transaction ID. Exact BigInt aggregate full/partial reserved debt cannot exceed original charge under purchase-row and common charge advisory locks. Existing failed/uncertain debts conservatively retain capacity; explicit verified excess remains separate.

findings.category: Admin / Refunds and Customer / My Card withdrawal
findings.trigger: A full Flutterwave refund is below minimum or fractional, so dispatchRefund returns reviewRequired without submitting it.
findings.issue: Caller still marked original payment refunded, returned success and notified that money was on its way despite no provider POST.
findings.evidence: Fresh isolated HTTP/PG probe charged5000kobo; providerPOST0,route200,card payment_status refunded;0/1passed before repair.
findings.after: Admin/customer reserve issuance, withdrawal and durable debt in the same transaction; historical wallet-credit clawback is included. Paid charge and refund_pending issuance remain until exact successful provider lookup, with cumulative settled full/partial amount equal to original charge. Pending/manual-review API/notification copy does not claim disbursement.

findings.category: Shared / Refund reconciliation and Admin / Payment diagnostics
findings.trigger: Older manual-review pending refunds fill the bounded sweep, followed by a newer queued refund.
findings.issue: ORDER BY created_at never rotates unresolvable rows, starving future refundable debts. Summary ignored refund reviewRequired/errored.
findings.evidence: Fresh isolated PG probe with limit1: older review_required row selected across3sweeps; newer queued refund generated0mockPOST;0/1passed before repair.
findings.after: Refund sweeps order by updated_at/created_at/id and rotate every unresolved row in finally. Global manual/failed debt counts include items outside the batch and contribute to attention. Lost-response claims never automatically resubmit.

findings.trigger: A historical card request has no charged_kobo, and its plan's current catalog price has changed.
findings.issue: Withdrawal substituted mutable plan amount for the missing original charge, inconsistent with stricter verify/admin/reconcile quote handling.
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed fallback ternary at withdrawal amount derivation; no production historical rows inspected.
findings.after: Customer withdrawal requires a positive bounded charged_kobo before reservation/clawback. Missing original charge rejects without current catalog fallback.

findings.category: Customer / Wallet and My Card; Company / Billing; Shared callbacks/recovery
findings.trigger: A failed hosted checkout attempt has stored transaction ID A; a later strictly verified successful attempt returns different ID B.
findings.issue: COALESCE(existing,verified) preserves old failed/init identifier when recognizing the successful charge, violating receipt traceability.
findings.evidence: Source-confirmed successful-transition SQL in completeTopUp, card manual verification, card reconciliation and webhook. No claim credit amount was wrong.
findings.after: Verified successful processor ID replaces old failed/init ID on the first paid transition in top-up/card manual/webhook/cron owners. Already-paid duplicate guards preserve the recognized successful identity. Independent card probes and top-up webhook failed→paid test exercise this.
